rationale: The `uses` key has three meanings in GitHub Actions and only the PATH decides which. At `jobs.<job>.uses` it names a reusable workflow this job INVOKES, so the edge is `calls`. At `jobs.<job>.steps[].uses` it names an action this step runs, so the edge is `imports`. The forbid half is the point: before the role was read from the path, all four sites took the imports branch and the two reusable workflows were labelled as imports of third-party actions. Confidence on the call is 1.0 because the ROLE is a parse fact — the key sits where GitHub Actions admits nothing else — while the TARGET is cross-file and so carries resolved:false rather than a fabricated bind.
